paper.title: CADET: A Modular Platform for Evaluating Distributed Cooperative Autonomy in Connected Autonomous Vehicles
paper.claim: The paper states that CADET is open source and directs readers to the official project page for code and a demo.

observations: The page exposes the paper, videos, architecture, evaluation figures, and descriptive experiment details.
The Access Code button is disabled and has no repository destination.
The page metadata and abstract retain an anonymous.4open.science link, but the audited endpoint returned a not_connected error.
No fixed source commit, release archive, dependency lock, scenario manifest, model checkpoint, or license was obtainable from the official page during this audit.

candidateImpact.reason: The proposed adaptive search requires the actual orchestrator, scenario controls, and logs.
The proposed intervention graph requires reproducible platform controls and source-level instrumentation.
The local transport, model, and TTC-TTE contracts cannot be executed or independently verified from the paper and videos alone.

allowedUse: Use the paper as primary evidence that distributed placement, network tails, visibility, and concurrent load can change task-level safety in the authors' experiments.
Use the published experiment design as a comparator or motivation.
Retain a CADET-dependent candidate only as a conditional reserve until a fixed public release is obtained.
forbiddenUse: Do not call CADET an executable public asset in the current snapshot.
Do not quote a reproducible source commit, license, scenario count, or checkpoint that was not obtained.
Do not present a proposed CADET experiment as runnable now.
Do not substitute a similarly named unrelated repository.
recheckTriggers: The official Access Code button gains a repository or archive link.
The authors publish a fixed release, artifact DOI, or institutional repository.
The anonymous review repository reconnects and exposes code, license, and a stable snapshot.
